doc.title: Harry "Sweets" Edison interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, September 3, 1995

title: Opening and welcome
summary: Monk Rowe introduces the Hamilton College archive filming and welcomes Edison, who says he is honored.

story.theme_name: Opening the interview: Monk Rowe's welcome and archive boilerplate
story.community_name: Opening the Hamilton College interview: introductions and boilerplate

blocks.x: My name is Monk Rowe. We are filming today for the Hamilton College Jazz Archive. It’s a special day for us because we’re here today with one of the kings of the trumpet, Sweets Edison.
It’s a great pleasure to have you here.
It’s a pleasure. It’s a compliment to me that you even invited me to do it. I feel honored.
Well we are in the process of getting some stories from some of our greatest musicians in the country. And we are very thrilled to have you here.
It’s a thrill to be here.
And we are interested in hearing your stories and, of course where you got your nickname, we have to ask that, but—
